data.title: Perspective Therapeutics Reports Updated VMT01 Melanoma Trial Results
data.description:
Perspective Therapeutics ( (CATX) ) has provided an update.

On November 6, 2026, Perspective Therapeutics announced updated interim results from a Phase 1/2a trial of [212Pb]lapemelanotide zapixetar (VMT01), an investigational targeted alpha therapy for heavily pretreated patients with MC1R-positive unresectable or metastatic melanoma. The update covered 20 patients across three monotherapy dose cohorts and was presented at the SITC annual meeting.

At the 3.0 mCi dose, two of eight patients achieved partial responses, with one response continuing approximately 40 weeks after initial treatment; the cohort recorded a 75% disease-control rate and durable stabilization in two patients. Across all 20 patients, no dose-limiting toxicities, treatment-related serious adverse events or adverse-event-related discontinuations were reported, providing clinical and safety data for the company’s ongoing dose evaluation and development planning.

data.title: Driven Brands Delays Quarterly Filing Amid Restatement Review
data.description:
Driven Brands Holdings ( (DRVN) ) has released a notification of late filing.

Driven Brands Holdings Inc. filed Form 12b-25, a notification of late filing, for the financial period ended September 26, 2026. The delayed report is its Form 10-Q (Quarter Report) for the third quarter of 2026.

The company said its Audit Committee determined on October 31, 2026, that previously issued financial statements must be restated. The review covers fiscal years 2023 through 2025 and earlier 2026 quarterly information, after errors were identified while preparing subsidiary statements connected to the company’s whole-business securitization.

Management is assessing how the restatement affects internal control over financial reporting and disclosure controls. Driven Brands had already reported material weaknesses and is evaluating whether additional weaknesses or broader disclosures are needed, while taking remediation steps.

The company did not provide a firm filing date, saying it is dedicating significant resources to completing the restatement and the 2026 Form 10-Q (Quarter Report) as soon as practicable. Investors should therefore expect the timing to depend on the continuing review and preparation of amended financial reports.

Driven Brands indicated that a significant change in results may appear in the delayed report. However, management said it cannot currently provide a reliable estimate of the impact on prior-period financial statements because the review may identify additional errors.

The company cautioned that these expectations are forward-looking statements, not guarantees. Risks include further accounting adjustments, additional control weaknesses, delayed filings, restatement costs, possible effects on Nasdaq listing requirements and financing agreements, litigation, and regulatory inquiries.

Driven Brands said it continues working to complete the restatement, strengthen its controls, and file the delayed report and related amendments. The notification was signed on November 6, 2026, by Michael F. Diamond, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.

data.title: Controladora Vuela Reports October Traffic Growth as International Capacity Expands
data.description:
Controladora Vuela Compania de Aviacion SAB de CV ( (VLRS) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Controladora Vuela Compañía de Aviación, known as Volaris, is an ultra-low-cost airline serving Mexico, the United States, Central America and South America. It provides point-to-point passenger flights and low fares, targeting visiting-friends-and-relatives travelers and cost-conscious business and leisure customers.

On November 6, 2026, Volaris reported October traffic: capacity rose 7.7% year over year, international capacity 27.5%, and the airline added five Guadalajara routes to Atlanta, Boston, Nashville, Raleigh-Durham and Washington, D.C. Total RPMs increased 3.3%, passengers reached 2.6 million and international RPMs jumped 21.7%, while domestic RPMs fell 8.4%; the load factor declined 3.5 points to 82.4% as new capacity ramped up.

data.title: Acrivon Acquires Aqilion’s JAK1 and PKCθ Inhibitor Programs
data.description:
Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc. ( (ACRV) ) has shared an update.

On November 6, 2026, Acrivon announced it had acquired Aqilion AB’s oral JAK1 inhibitor programs, including Phase 2-ready ACR-525, and its PKCθ inhibitor preclinical program for inflammatory and autoimmune diseases. The transaction included related intellectual property, data, regulatory filings and drug supply, was completed for cash, and created no future royalty or milestone obligations.

Acrivon said the acquisition made immunology and inflammation a strategic pillar alongside oncology, with eosinophilic esophagitis identified as ACR-525’s first potential indication after two completed Phase 1 studies. Its AP3 profiling compared ACR-525 with six approved JAK inhibitors and dupilumab, characterizing it as highly selective with minimal off-target effects versus approved JAK inhibitors and broader cellular effects than dupilumab.
